svg.aria-label: The pass criteria written before the first request, beside the result at three thousand users. The criteria are p95 under 500 milliseconds, p99 under one second, and errors under one per cent. At three thousand users the p95 came back at 1,356 milliseconds and the p99 at 2,287 milliseconds, both failing, while the error rate was zero per cent and passed. Two of three criteria failed, and the one that passed is the one most dashboards watch. The caption notes that after a run, 1,356 milliseconds is easy to argue yourself into, and before the run it is simply over a line you already drew.
svg.text: WRITE THE PASS MARK BEFORE THE FIRST REQUEST
